up: Return the compounds reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5728930. For each compound, provide its ChEMBL compound ID (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id) and its preferred name (molecule_dictionary.pref_name). If a preferred name is not available, still include the compound.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, md.pref_name
FROM docs d
JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
LEFT JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5728930';
